guideHelp: /help general: shows general information about Gosquad.
/help report: shows how to report violation.
/help code: shows codes for icons, flags and symbols.
/<command> help: shows help for specific command.
Checks a command's price, minimum level to run it,
& min role to run it for free. E.g. /kill requirement.
reportHelp: The most important thing about reporting is accuracy.
You must have evidence to prove your claim.
At least one video or screenshot is required.
The evidence must show the violation clearly.
Visit our Discord for more information.
rulesHelp: No bad words on chat, name, tag, etc..
Don't team up in FFA server.
Don't create a rule that doesn't exist
Complete rules would be on our Discord server.
Note: server owners may have different/additional rules.
banCmdHelp: /ban <cl> 2: bans player for 2 days using coins.
/ban <cl> 2 <reason>: bans player for 2 days using admin.
/ban all 2: bans all players for 2 days.
<cl> is player's client id. Type /cl to check it.
Also can use local id, account id, name, account name.
/ban sita haf 2: bans sita, hafsah for 2 days.
<scope> can be global, ffa, or team.
banAdmCmdHelp: /ban server: hides server from the public party list.
unbanCmdHelp: /unban <scope>: unbans self from the scope bans.
<scope> can be global, ffa, or team.
/unban team: If banned from team server.
unbanAdmCmdHelp: /unban server: shows server in the public party list.
cheatCmdHelp: /<cmd> <id1> <id2>: runs command on 2 players at once.
<id> is player's index. Type /id to check it.
You also can use name as replacement for <id>.
/<cmd> sita aur: runs command on sita, aura.
coinAdmCmdHelp: Note: coins will be taken from server's coin.
commandCmdHelp: /command info <cmd>: shows basic info of command.
Free access needs reason, otherwise will use coins.
E.g. /end Type whatever valid reason here.
commandAdmCmdHelp: /command role <cmd> <role>: sets cmd free access role.
Note: not every command has free access role.
effectCmdHelp: /effect add spark: adds spark effect to inventory.
/effect add spark 3: extends spark validity by 3 days.
funCmdHelp: /<cmd> <id1> <id2>: runs command on 2 players at once.
<id> is player's index. Type /id to check it.
You also can use name as replacement for <id>.
/<cmd> haf aur: runs command on hafsah, aura.
Some commands need extra argument, otherwise: random.
Example: /color all red. 'Red' is extra argument.
helpCmdIconHelp: Just type '\' followed by an available code. Example:
/help code icon: shows sample icon codes.
/help code symbol: shows sample symbol codes.
/help code flag: shows sample flag codes.
Visit Discord for the complete list.
hideCmdHelp: /hide role 2: hides role from public for 2 days.
/hide list: checks what items that can be hidden.
hideAdmCmdHelp: /hide create <item>: creates a new hidden item.
hugCmdHelp: /<cmd> id1 id2: runs command on 2 players at once.
<id> is player's index. Type /id to check it.
You also can use name as replacement for <id>.
/<cmd> sita haf: runs command on sita, hafsah
iconCmdHelp: /icon add \crown: adds crown icon to inventory.
/icon limit: checks max icon number and length.
kickCmdHelp: /kick <cl>: kicks player from server using coins.
/kick all: kicks all players from server.
<cl> is player's client id. Type /cl to check it.
Also can use local id, account id, name, account name.
/kick sita haf aur: kicks sita, hafsah, aura.
languageCmdHelp: Language support may be limited to help only.
Only a few languages may be available.
Language other than english may be outdated.
Please help us to translate it.
levelCmdHelp: Or let it upgrades automatically with score.
/level convert <number>: trades number of levels with coins.
levelAdmCmdHelp: YOU MAY WANT TO WARN PLAYERS ABOUT THIS:
Ranking dropped below 70th > Downgrade by 1 level (max).
Ranking dropped below 150th > Downgrade by 2 levels (max).
Ranking dropped below 250th > Downgrade by 3 levels (max).
muteCmdHelp: /mute <cl> 2: mutes player for 2 days using coins.
/mute all 2: mutes all players for 2 days.
<cl> is player's client id. Type /cl to check it.
Also can use local id, account id, name, account name.
/mute sita aur 2: mutes sita, aura for 2 days.
passwdCmdHelp: Min password is 4 characters, max is 16.
petCmdHelp: /pet add taobao: adds taobao pet to inventory.
/pet add taobao 3: extends taobao validity by 3 days.
removeCmdHelp: /remove <id>: removes player to lobby using coins.
/remove all: removes all players to lobby.
<id> is player's index. Type /id to check it.
You also can use name as replacement for <id>.
/remove sita haf aur: removes sita, hafsah, aura.
roleCmdHelp: /role price: check roles' prices and details.
/role add admin 1: makes self admin for 1 month.
/role tag admin cool: overrides admin's default tag to cool.
/role remtag admin: changes admin's tag back to default.
/role anim admin right: changes admin's role animation to right.
roleAdmCmdHelp: /role assign <cl> admin 7: makes player admin role for 7 days.
/role revoke <cl> admin: takes player's admin role.
/role eligible <cl> true: makes player eligible for admin.
/role deftag owner cool: changes default owner tag to cool.
/role import: make self as owner (please read hint).
statsCmdHelp: /stats convert <score>: trades stats score with coins.
Watch your betrayal counts. You may get banned.
symbolCmdHelp: /symbol add \trophy: adds trophy symbol to inventory.
/symbol limit: checks max symbol number and length.
Emoji/smiley is also suitable for symbol.
tagCmdHelp: /tag add Winner: adds 'Winner' tag to inventory.
/tag add "Top Win": quotes it to use space.
/tag limit: checks max tag number and length.
/tag color 1 red: changes 1st tag color to red.
voteoffCmdHelp: /voteoff all 2: disables all players for 2 days.
<cl> is player's client id. Type /cl to check it.
Also can use local id, account id, name, account name.
/voteoff haf aur 2: disables hafsah, aura for 2 days.
mvoteoffCmdHelp: /mvoteoff all 2: disables all players for 2 days.
<cl> is player's client id. Type /cl to check it.
Also can use local id, account id, name, account name.
/mvoteoff sita aur 2: disables sita, aura for 2 days.
